target.description: Figure 4D binary context decoding conditional on actual position from speed-equalized CA1 population vectors, preserving the source learning-session support and comparison to its conditional decoder. It is an original paper endpoint; changes in hierarchy depth or curve fidelity are not decoding improvement.

dataset.description: Author ISTA record 18991, Chiossi_etal_2025_PNAS_data.zip, with sorted spikes, unit descriptions, linearized positions, trial CSVs and session shifts; no raw-voltage endpoint is implied.

cohort.description: Five rats recorded over five days, 25 recording sessions. The missing first sleep recording is disclosed and does not justify narrowing the awake conditional-decoding cohort. Repeated session columns must not be treated as unique independent neurons across days.

split.description: Methods specify 100 stratified 70/30 population-vector splits followed by stratified bootstrap resampling within partitions, with matched draws across methods. Historical draw identities/seeds are unavailable, but documented new draws under this same original protocol and population are admissible with recorded seeds/provenance, paired candidate-author draws and predeclared justified calibration tolerance. Changing to animal/day/whole-trial holdouts changes the task.

inputs.description: Original Figure 4 speed-equalized population vectors with actual position as the conditioning variable and context as the prediction label. Do not replace actual position with an easier or different condition, or silently use example-default raw vectors.

preprocessing.description: Recover the complete source speed-equalization/GLM-to-PV and decoder settings for Figure 4. Clock conversions must retain 20 kHz spikes, 24 kHz session boundaries and 50 Hz positions. The existing raw-PV Ward-tree pipeline is not this input route.

metric.description: Paper Figure 4/Methods describe a normalized absolute label difference while calling it accuracy; code uses exact-match accuracy_score in the global route. For binary context, accuracy and one-minus-normalized-error can coincide, but the source scoring transformation must be explicitly reconciled and the conditional zero-return array cannot be used as a score.

aggregation.description: Methods average conditional decoding over conditioning groups; exact Figure 4D aggregation over repeats, sessions and rats plus its numeric baseline have not been recovered. Preserve the original 25-session endpoint rather than select a favorable session or bootstrap.

full_panel.description: The125 quantitative session-arm findings and four source-supported directions currently represent only the Figure4D/companion4B context-decoding subset. The original registered outputs remain REQUIRED BUT UNREPRESENTED: learning-related CA1 hierarchy and variance-versus-depth curves, and speed-adjusted spatial/context coding and conditional decoding across learning and probe sessions. Required hierarchy companions include source root-normalized context/direction/position variance-depth curves across behavioral groups, naive/expert contrasts, reward-location-specific context branches (Figure3D-F), and the speed-equalized companion discussed with SI FigureS7. Required spatial/context and learning/probe obligations include source spatial conditional-decoding and reward-location/behavior relationships (Figure4E-F); the exact mapping of the registered probe obligation to primary methods/supplement, original probe roster and companion controls is still unresolved. Their inclusion cannot be removed by the current narrower improvement target. Exact per-output identities, curve/bin/node support, learning/probe memberships, numerical source targets, tolerances and uncertainty rules are not frozen. No placeholder vector-as-scalar findings are created; no complete-panel reproduction or final outcome admission is supported. Within the represented context-decoding subset, retain all25 named sessions from five rats, all100 source-protocol repetitions and all five arms: global, global_context_shuffle, conditional, conditional_context_shuffle and conditional_position_shuffle. These125 quantities and12,500 structural session-arm-repeat slots do not authenticate PV membership or independent replicates. Fine Position versus coarse Region support, missing-condition handling and final source session/rat aggregation also remain unresolved.

permitted_observations.description: The common paper+data condition uses the paper and released sorted spikes, cell descriptions, position, session shifts and behavioral/trial metadata needed to reconstruct the original speed-equalized PVs. The paired +author-code condition may add only the pinned author source. Original behavioral context labels are public source observations; their availability must be disclosed rather than called secret. In each source-protocol supervised fit, only the training partition may supply context labels to fitting; actual held-out position is the conditioning variable and held-out context supports independent scoring. Common delivery, permissible development exposure, source-PV identities and execution enforcement are not yet frozen for Figure4D.
